Someone open sourced a free AI trading team that researches stocks for you, and it’s already past 100,000 stars on GitHub.

You ask ChatGPT about a stock and get one answer, and nobody really double checks it before you put money in.

This tool builds the whole team. Analysts cover financials, sentiment and charts, then a bull researcher and a bear researcher argue over the stock. Only then does a trader propose the trade, and a risk team and a portfolio manager make the final decision.

It’s research and not financial advice.
